description:
Download Link:

https://github.com/Moffhul/Starsector-Faces-in-the-Void/releases/download/v0.5-Faces-in-the-Void/Faces.in.the.Void_v0.5-beta.zip

All images are AI-generated.

Images were created using Midjourney AI and the vanilla portrait assets.

While I've put a lot of work into this and am proud of this mod so far, I make no claims of being an artist.

I just work with technology, have fiddled with AI, love this game and wanted to share.

Faces in the Void replaces all vanilla human portraits in Starsector. At this time, it also adds 69 additional portraits.

This is a work-in-progress with portraits being tweaked and replaced. Also, more bonus portraits will be added over time.

v0.5 the Hegemony Reinforced
v0.5 includes 21 bonus portraits exclusive to the Hegemony. 3 earlier vanilla replacements have been updated with

Hegemony Bonus sheet:

Spoiler[close]v0.5 update notes

Spoilerv0.5-beta 6/7/26

MAIN UPDATE:

As I am now focusing on adding additional bonus content rather than re-doing existing portraits, v0.5 adds 21 bonus portraits to the Hegemony, hopefully cutting down a bit on repeat portraits.

Three of the original FiV Hegemony replacements that were bugging me have also been updated with new portraits. I've tried to make them at least slightly closer to the originals. Those are portrait_hegemony02, 03 and 05.

The Persean League will receive a similar expansion in the next update.

[close]

This is the first mod I've ever released to others. Feedback is welcome.

Current portraits included in the mod:

Tri-tachyon and the Sindrian Diktat
